commonHeaders.X-API-Key: Required when API_SECRET is set on backend. Value = API_SECRET from env. For server-side calls (cron, webhooks) only — do not store in client apps.

routes.name: auth.register
routes.description: Register AppUser via Supabase Auth (proxy).

routes.name: auth.login
routes.description: Log in AppUser via Supabase Auth (proxy).

routes.name: auth.refresh
routes.description: Refresh access_token using refresh_token.

routes.name: auth.logout
routes.description: Log out the current AppUser in Supabase.

routes.name: me.show
routes.description: User profile + subscription + scan_usage.

routes.name: me.update
routes.description: Update profile (first_name, last_name). Validation: required, min:2, max:50, regex for Unicode letters, spaces, hyphen, apostrophe.

routes.name: me.destroy
routes.description: Soft-delete AppUser account.

routes.name: me.settings.show
routes.description: Get user settings (currency, language, timezone).

routes.name: me.settings.create
routes.description: Create settings (onboarding). Returns 409 if settings already exist. currency/language/timezone — Rule::in against allowed lists.

body.currency: string (USD, EUR, GBP, UAH, PLN, CHF, CAD, AUD, JPY, CNY, RUB, MXN, INR, BRL)

routes.name: me.settings.update
routes.description: Update existing settings. Fields optional (sometimes) — partial updates allowed.

routes.name: categories.index
routes.description: List categories and subcategories; excludes user-disabled categories.

routes.name: funnel.visibilityQuestions
routes.description: Onboarding funnel questions. Backend returns structure; frontend translates via i18n: t(translation_key + '.title'), t(translation_key + '.description').

routes.name: visibilityTags.index
routes.description: List visibility tags with enabled and translation_key for the current user. Frontend: t(translation_key) for toggle labels.

routes.name: me.categoryVisibility.update
routes.description: Enable/disable category sets by visibility_tag. enabled: false — inserts rows into app_user_category_settings; enabled: true — deletes them. 422 if no categories exist for the tag (run php artisan categories:seed).

body.visibility_tag: string (kids, car, rent, insurance, loan, mortgage)

422.message: No categories found for visibility_tag 'X'. Run: php artisan categories:seed

routes.name: transactions.scan
routes.description: AI receipt scan: upload image, returns proposed transaction. Requires active subscription and available scan quota.

routes.name: transactions.voice
routes.description: Premium: voice expense entry. Multipart audio is transcribed and parsed into a draft expense (same TransactionResource as scan). Does not use AI scan quota. Requires feature voice_expense (Premium plan).

body.audio: file (mp3, m4a, wav, webm, ogg, etc.; max 5 MB)

routes.name: transactions.confirm
routes.description: Confirm AI-generated transaction (makes it visible in lists and summaries).

routes.name: transactions.index
routes.description: List confirmed transactions for the current user (pagination and filters).

routes.name: transactions.store
routes.description: Create manual transaction (1 transaction + 1 item).

routes.name: transactions.show
routes.description: Get a single transaction by id for the current user.

routes.name: transactions.update
routes.description: Update manual transaction (total_amount/date/type/category).

routes.name: transactions.destroy
routes.description: Soft-delete transaction for the current user.

routes.name: transactions.summary.index
routes.description: Expense summary by Level 1 categories for date range.

routes.name: transactions.summary.show
routes.description: Expense summary by subcategories for the selected category over date range.

routes.name: transactions.export
routes.description: CSV export of expenses for date range. Basic/Plus/Premium only.

routes.name: analytics.dashboard
routes.description: Analytics for a calendar month (confirmed expenses, minor units). Plus/Premium only.
routes.response: JSON: month, currency, period, overview, categories, trends
